title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Enrollment Standard: One Open Enrollment per Member
content:
**Standard.** A member holds at most 1 Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment that is not terminated at any time. Enrollments in terminated status stay on file as history and do not count toward this cap of 1.

**Opening a new enrollment.** A new enrollment may be opened for a member only when no enrollment of that member is pending effective, active, in COBRA continuation or in COBRA grace. This is judged from the system's enrollment records for that member — the member's own account of their coverage does not decide it — and it is judged before the new enrollment is opened.

**Change of design at renewal.** A sponsor that moves a member to a different plan design at renewal does so by ending the old enrollment and opening a new one, and accumulators move with the member under the prior-carrier accumulator credit rule of the Pharmacy Benefit Plan.

## Status of existing enrollments and the effect on a new one

| Status of an existing enrollment of the same member | Counts toward the cap of 1 | A new enrollment may be opened while it stands |
|---|---|---|
| Pending effective | Yes | No |
| Active | Yes | No |
| COBRA continuation | Yes | No |
| COBRA grace | Yes | No |
| Terminated | No (history only) | This enrollment does not stand in the way |

## Cases (hypothetical members)

- A member's only enrollment on file is terminated. Nothing counts toward the cap, so a new enrollment may be opened.
- A member has one terminated enrollment from an earlier plan year and one active enrollment. The active enrollment counts; no new enrollment may be opened.
- A member has an enrollment in COBRA grace. That enrollment is not terminated and counts toward the cap; no new enrollment may be opened while it stands.
- A sponsor moves a member from one plan design to another at renewal. The old enrollment is ended first, leaving the member with no enrollment that is not terminated, and the new enrollment is then opened.
